core.remediation: Update WordPress core to 4.7.2 or later. This flaw lets an unauthenticated attacker edit any post via the REST API.
core.title: WordPress 4.7.0/4.7.1 REST API content injection

core.remediation: Update WordPress core to 4.7.2 or later.
core.title: WordPress 4.7.x taxonomy-term SQL injection (authenticated)

contact-form-7.note: Unrestricted file upload + RCE, CVSS 10.0, Dec 2020; fixed in 5.3.2
contact-form-7.remediation: Update Contact Form 7 to 5.3.2 or later immediately. Only forms with a file-upload field are exposed.
contact-form-7.title: Contact Form 7 < 5.3.2 unrestricted file upload (CVE-2020-35489)

revslider.note: Publicly documented arbitrary file upload, 2014; fixed in 4.2
revslider.remediation: Update Slider Revolution to 4.2 or later, or remove it. Older versions allow unauthenticated file upload.
revslider.title: Slider Revolution (revslider) <= 4.1.4 arbitrary file upload

wp-file-manager.note: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload + RCE, CVSS 9.8, exploited in the wild Aug-Sep 2020, CISA KEV; fixed in 6.9
wp-file-manager.remediation: Update File Manager to 6.9 or later immediately, and check wp-content/plugins/wp-file-manager/lib/files/ for unauthorized files.
wp-file-manager.title: File Manager (wp-file-manager) < 6.9 arbitrary file upload / RCE (CVE-2020-25213)

wp-file-manager.note: Backup disclosure via fm_backups directory; fixed in 6.5
wp-file-manager.remediation: Update File Manager to 6.5 or later, and delete any exposed backup files.
wp-file-manager.title: File Manager (wp-file-manager) <= 6.4 backup disclosure (CVE-2020-24312)

wp-mobile-detector.note: Publicly documented unauthenticated arbitrary file upload, 2016; fixed in 3.6
wp-mobile-detector.remediation: Update WP Mobile Detector to 3.6 or later, or remove it.
wp-mobile-detector.title: WP Mobile Detector < 3.6 arbitrary file upload

wysija-newsletters.note: Publicly documented unauthenticated file upload, 2014; fixed in 2.6.8
wysija-newsletters.remediation: Update MailPoet to 2.6.8 or later, or remove it.
wysija-newsletters.title: MailPoet (Wysija) < 2.6.8 file upload
